readme:
# Finn.no Scraper

Scrape listings from [finn.no](https://www.finn.no), a Norwegian classifieds platform and job board (Schibsted group). Supports marketplace, jobs, real estate, cars, and mobility.

## How it works

1. Go to [finn.no](https://www.finn.no) and set up your search with all desired filters (category, price, location, make, model, etc.)
2. Copy the URL from your browser
3. Paste it into the **Search URLs** input
4. Run the actor

The actor extracts all listings matching your search, with automatic pagination.

## Use with AI Agents (MCP)

Connect this actor to any MCP-compatible AI client — Claude Desktop, Claude.ai, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or custom agents.

**Apify MCP server URL:**

```
https://mcp.apify.com?tools=santamaria-automations/finn-no-scraper
```

**Example prompt once connected:**

> "Use `finn-no-scraper` to scrape company data from finn no. Return results as a table."

Clients that support dynamic tool discovery (Claude.ai, VS Code) will receive the full input schema automatically via `add-actor`.

## Features

- **Any filter combination** -- Whatever you can filter on finn.no, the actor can scrape
- **Sort by newest** -- Default `newest` ensures scheduled scrapes always return the latest postings first
- **Multiple searches** -- Paste multiple URLs to run several searches in one run
- **Detail enrichment** -- Optionally get full description, company URL, employment type (jobs)
- **All verticals** -- Marketplace (Torget), Jobs (Jobb), Real Estate (Eiendom), Cars (Bil), Mobility
- **Fast & cheap** -- HTTP-only, 128 MB, pay-per-result

## Input

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `searchUrls` | string[] | — | One or more finn.no search URLs |
| `sortBy` | enum | `newest` | Sort order: `newest`, `relevance`, `deadline`, `nearest` |
| `maxResults` | integer | 100 (10 only when no `searchUrls` and no limits are set: the demo) | Maximum total listings across ALL `searchUrls` combined (a global cap) |
| `maxResultsPerQuery` | integer | 100 | Maximum listings per search URL. Use it to split the total evenly per URL, because `maxResults` is global |
| `includeDetails` | boolean | true | Fetch the detail page for the full description and all job, real estate and car fields |

**sortBy values:**

| Value | Finn.no label | Description |
|-------|--------------|-------------|
| `newest` | Publisert | Published date, newest first (recommended for scheduled scrapes) |
| `relevance` | Mest relevant | Keyword relevance ranking |
| `deadline` | Frist tidligst | Earliest application deadline first |
| `nearest` | Nærmest | Closest to your location filter |

> The `sortBy` param is applied via finn.no's server-side `sort=` URL parameter. If your search URL already contains an explicit `sort=` value, the actor respects it and does not override.

## Output

| Field | Description | Source |
|-------|-------------|--------|
| `title` | Listing title | Search |
| `price` / `currency` | Price in NOK | Search |
| `location` | City or address | Search |
| `category` | Detected vertical (marketplace/jobs/cars/realestate) | Search |
| `company_name` | Employer (jobs) or seller | Search |
| `company_url` | Employer website | Detail |
| `employment_type` | FULL_TIME, PART_TIME, etc. (jobs) | Detail |
| `image_url` | Primary image URL | Search |
| `description` | Full listing description | Detail |
| `posted_at` / `expires_at` | Publication and expiry dates | Both |
| `source_url` | Direct link on finn.no | Both |
| `description_full`, `contact_emails`, `contact_phones` | Full plain-text description and public contact details (jobs, real estate, cars) | Detail |
| `finnkode`, `last_updated`, `address`, `postal_code`, `city`, `latitude`, `longitude`, `image_urls` | Ad code, last update time, address, coordinates and all image URLs (real estate and cars) | Detail |
| `asking_price`, `total_price`, `shared_costs_monthly`, `monthly_rent`, `sales_costs`, `estate_tax_yearly`, `tax_value` | Real estate prices and monthly costs in NOK | Detail |
| `property_type`, `ownership_type`, `rooms`, `bedrooms`, `usable_area_m2`, `primary_area_m2`, `plot_area_m2`, `floor`, `year_built`, `energy_rating`, `facilities` | Real estate property facts | Detail |
| `viewings`, `floorplan_urls`, `broker_name`, `broker_title`, `broker_company`, `broker_phone`, `broker_email` | Real estate viewing dates, floor plans and broker contact | Detail |
| `make`, `model`, `year`, `mileage_km`, `fuel`, `gearbox`, `body_type`, `drive_type`, `color`, `engine_power_hp`, `registration_number`, `vin`, `first_registered`, `specifications` | Car details and the full specification list | Detail |
| `seller_type`, `seller_name`, `seller_address`, `seller_org_number`, `seller_phone` | Car seller details. `seller_phone` is a number printed in the ad text and is `null` when the ad shows none | Detail |
| `detail_status` | `ok` when the detail page was read, `failed` when details were requested but the page held no detail data (billed as a basic listing), `null` when `includeDetails` is off | Detail |

## Pricing

No start fee -- pay only for results:

| Event | Cost |
|-------|------|
| Listing (basic) | $0.003 |
| Listing (with details) | $0.005 |

**100 listings = $0.30** (basic) or **$0.50** (with details)

Listings whose detail page could not be loaded or held no detail data are billed as basic listings.

## Examples

### Latest developer jobs in Oslo
```json
{
  "searchUrls": ["https://www.finn.no/job/fulltime/search.html?q=utvikler&location=0.20061"],
  "sortBy": "newest",
  "maxResults": 100,
  "includeDetails": true
}
```

### Jobs sorted by earliest application deadline
```json
{
  "searchUrls": ["https://www.finn.no/job/fulltime/search.html?q=ingeniør"],
  "sortBy": "deadline",
  "maxResults": 50
}
```

### Cars under 200K NOK
```json
{
  "searchUrls": ["https://www.finn.no/mobility/search/car?price_to=200000&registration_class=1&variant=0.801"],
  "sortBy": "newest",
  "maxResults": 50
}
```

### Multiple searches in one run
```json
{
  "searchUrls": [
    "https://www.finn.no/bap/forsale/search.html?q=iphone",
    "https://www.finn.no/job/fulltime/search.html?q=utvikler",
    "https://www.finn.no/realestate/homes/search.html?q=leilighet"
  ],
  "sortBy": "newest",
  "maxResults": 200,
  "maxResultsPerQuery": 80
}
```

### Quick SERP-only scan (fast, less data)
```json
{
  "searchUrls": ["https://www.finn.no/bap/forsale/search.html?q=macbook"],
  "sortBy": "newest",
  "maxResults": 200,
  "includeDetails": false
}
```
